title: Nyakati na Hali (Theme 5: Unyanyasaji wa kijinsia)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child puts the time on kuwa (-li-, -ta-) and the continuing action on the main verb with -ki- or -na-.
representations: a timeline with a long arrow
contexts: gender-based violence (unyanyasaji wa kijinsia): reporting what was happening

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi iko katika ujao hali ya kuendelea?" Kwa nini "Alikuwa akisoma jana" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ujao hali ya kuendelea hutumia atakuwa akisoma.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Alikuwa akipika humaanisha nini?" Kwa nini "Alimaliza kupika" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Alikuwa akipika ni uliopita hali ya kuendelea: tendo lilikuwa likiendelea.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi ni uliopita hali ya kuendelea?" Kwa nini "Alisoma jana" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Walikuwa wakicheza ni uliopita hali ya kuendelea.

checks.question: Badilisha kuwa ujao hali ya kuendelea: "Alikuwa akipika."
